_comment: bootstrap-tools' Roles: the lanes of its own Processes. Declared here, as bootstrap declares its own in bootstrap/scenarios/roles.json, so that every lane of a diagram in processes/ names a Role somebody defined. A lane names its Role with BPMN's partitionElementRef; it is not the Role (owner, 2026-10-16). The toolset carries a small content graph of its own (owner, 2026-09-30: "it is ok to have bootstrap-tools add in some content KG. the rendering bpmn is ok in bootstrap-tools, same for scenarios and such so 'render KG to githubpages' works and self described").
name: bootstrap-tools

roles.title: Site Publisher
roles.description: Renders a Knowledge Graph — the whole of it, or a list of its Subgraphs — for GitHub Pages at a publication root URL, has it deployed, checks what is served, and reports the push's status with one message. Performed by an agent running these tools, or by a Pages workflow running the same commands; the steps and the report are the same either way. It does not decide WHICH root URL or WHICH Subgraphs: whoever started the process says, and a staging root and a release root are the same process with a different answer.

roles.title: GitHub Pages
roles.description: The host that serves what the Site Publisher deployed, at the publication root URL. It receives a deployment — a commit on the `gh-pages` branch — and serves it, deciding nothing. Its skill is its contract, `github-pages`, which `pages-status` tests (owner, 2026-10-16).
